115907.synopsis:
Before the apocalypse, Shen Ling was the chosen one, a privileged child. After the apocalypse, he became a big shot among human-powered beings. He met Chu Yu at the Capital City base, and it was love at first sight for him. Though Shen Ling is a straight man, he couldn’t resist the persistence of Chu Yu, who had once hung himself on a tree.
Chu Yu spent nearly ten years trying to get close to Shen Ling, guarding against all potential rivals, slowly wearing him down like a frog in boiling water. Finally, Shen Ling agreed to be with him. But then, just after, Shen Ling died alongside the Zombie King…
Then Shen Ling was reborn. He woke up ten months before the apocalypse struck. This time, he had enough time to stockpile supplies and recruit teammates. He’s definitely going to accept Chu Yu’s pursuit early this time around! But first, he has two teammates to raise, and they need to grow up before they can be of any use…

119747.synopsis:
Orange downloaded a restaurant management game and accidentally got a shabby restaurant and a takeaway system.
[Run a restaurant, renovate with krypton gold, and choose from a variety of decorations! ] 
[Draw cards to get recipes, and there are many types of random drops! ] 
Drawing cards…
Ding! Got an N card [Turnip Skin] 
Ding! Got an N card [Pork Dumplings] 
Note: Duplicate cards can be synthesized to upgrade the star! After the star upgrade, the taste is greatly improved!
[Are you ready to open? ARE YOU READY? ] 
Orange opened a restaurant with two N cards in sorrow.
The new store opened, and the foodies sneered at it at first.
“Boss, your cooking skills are not good. The ingredients are fresh and you can eat them casually.”
“If the portion is not enough, I will not order it again.”
Looking at the lonely three-star and four-star reviews on the takeaway system.
Orange turned her grief into motivation, drawing cards, combining cards, combining cards!
Later – the foodies slapped her in the face.
It smells so good, so good!
“Without radish peels for a day, the office worker will not be happy working overtime.”
“Why do I often have tears in my eyes? Because I love grilled fish balls deeply.”
“The most delicious shrimp dumplings!! The corners of my mouth are crazy after eating!”
“You can’t hide your love. Even if you close your eyes, tears will flow from the corners of your mouth.”
“The best beef sauce duck in the world! Love, crazy fan!”
Orange looked at the comment area with a frown. When did she spend money to hire a shill? It looks a bit professional.

133827.synopsis:
A’Feng picked up an amnesiac man and made him her husband.
After being married for two years, the couple shared a deep and harmonious bond.
Her husband, Fang Mengbai, was an ordinary schoolteacher—refined and handsome.
He loved her dearly, and A’Feng loved him just as much.
She believed the two of them would always remain like this—mutual respect, growing old together in peace.
Until one day, a man of extraordinary coldness and beauty, as icy and pure as snow, appeared.
The man claimed his name was He Fengchen, and that he was the *male spouse* of her husband, Fang Mengbai.
Her husband Fang Mengbai was, in truth, the foremost disciple of White Deer Academy—the world-renowned “Brush-and-Sword of Danching.”
Such a legendary figure of the righteous path had, overnight, betrayed his sect, annihilating the entire Beidou Sword Sect’s bloodline—hundreds of lives.
Only then, gravely wounded and robbed of his memories, was he “picked up” by A’Feng and brought home.
It was then that A’Feng realized she had transmigrated into a *pure-love novel.*
And her husband, Fang Mengbai, was the male protagonist—the “top” of that story.
—
He Fengchen was born of the Daoist sects—aloof, disciplined, pure and cold.
With his mastery of the zither and sword, graceful as flowing wind and falling snow, he and the Confucian “Brush-and-Sword” Fang Mengbai were known together as the Twin Pillars of Confucianism and Daoism.
Thirty years ago, the two had formed a soul-bond—until the day Fang Mengbai’s betrayal was revealed.
When He Fengchen finally found him, Fang Mengbai already had a young wife by his side.
At first, He Fengchen dismissed A’Feng entirely.
Until, one day, he could no longer tear his gaze away from her.
He had fallen, deeply and hopelessly, under her spell.
—
Once, Fang Mengbai and He Fengchen had been as harmonious as a perfect duet—only to later turn into mortal enemies, wishing nothing more than the other’s destruction.
Main Characters: A’Feng, He Fengchen, Fang Mengbai
One-Sentence Summary: A dose of Mary Sue literature.
Theme: Holding fast to the path of kindness.

141763.synopsis:
Liang Jinshu transmigrated.
After pulling an all-nighter to finish a novel recommended by her cousin—she woke up as the pampered, bullying, princess-syndrome-ridden female supporting character of the same name.
The supporting character was so utterly pretentious that the male lead, to whom she was engaged since childhood, loathed her to the extreme… Honestly, with the strong, independent, brilliant, filial, aloof, and beautiful female lead as a contrast, if the male lead still liked the supporting character, he’d have a screw loose. A female lead like that? Not just the male lead… Liang Jinshu… likes her too (nosebleed).
— When Liang Jinshu, who was known for her princess temper and penchant for wearing frilly pink bubble skirts, suddenly becomes A (assertive) and sà (cool/dashing)… Meng Qingci expresses that if she really wants to be friends with me, I’m not entirely unwilling (smile).
— Liang Jinshu: Why is it that when I stopped wearing bubble skirts, the men and women who used to dislike me are now coming to hit on me? They even want to be my mudguard? So annoying. Meng Qingci: Excuse me, I’ve claimed this woman’s motorcycle backseat.
—Warning: In the original book, the female lead was entirely focused on her career, and getting together with the male lead was just a natural progression, but they did genuinely date. In this novel, the female lead is forcefully bāi wān (bent, turned l**bian) early on… It’s essentially a showdown between two brilliant individuals with zero practical experience but perfect theoretical knowledge.
—Just act sāo (flirty/seductive) enough, and no one will see my helplessness.

143299.synopsis:
Alphas, who formed power in various strata of society through their outstanding abilities, chose in*est as a means to further solidify that power.
Alphas shared omegas within the family to prevent the family’s bloodline from leaking out, continuing reproduction solely with pure bloodlines and thereby prospering the family.
Within generations, it was common for alpha brothers to share omegas and carry on the bloodline, but unfortunately, the matriarch of Juwon Group could not bear an omega.
Like other alpha families, the owner family of Juwon Group, which was obsessed with pure bloodlines, thought of the half-baked omega born from a one-night stand with a beta long ago.
A half-baked mongrel omega born from seed theft.
In that way, Seowoo became the omega of his half-brothers.

149187.synopsis:
A prince of exalted rank and power, a noble and elegant marquis, a brilliantly talented top scholar, a general famed across the land—
the husbands most envied by the young ladies of the capital, Jiang Zhuo had married each of them in turn.
Unfortunately, once she lost the protection of her family, Jiang Zhuo had nothing but her beauty. Throughout her life she was reduced to a servant and a concubine, and she never met a good end.
In May, the summer flowers at the Buddhist temple were in full, dazzling bloom, and the lingering sandalwood incense lulled people toward drowsiness.
Jiang Zhuo, who once mocked herself for being stuck with a supporting-role script, jolted awake from a dream to find she had been reborn seven days before her family’s downfall.
Resign herself to fate? Impossible!
Given a second chance, Jiang Zhuo—who had sworn to stand on her own—would no longer pin her hopes on any man.
